articles.title: The Secret Superpower of Dogs in Art History
articles.summary: A new book argues that dogs in Western art do more than look adorable—they break down emotional barriers between species. With 250 artworks, from a 1501 puppy to a Border Collie as a child’s chair, it reveals how canine gazes connect us across centuries.

articles.title: Noah Kahan’s Hilarious PSA After a Concertgoer Leaves a Nasty Surprise
articles.summary: A viral video showed poop on the floor at Noah Kahan’s Philadelphia concert. The singer’s X response was equal parts plea and self-deprecating confession—he admitted to pooping his pants on stage once, but urged fans to spare venue workers the trauma.

articles.title: Serena Williams’s Stunning Wimbledon Return—and How to Watch It Free
articles.summary: Serena Williams enters Wimbledon as an unseeded wild card, her first Grand Slam since 2022. The tournament starts June 29 on ESPN, ESPN2, and ABC. Cord-cutters can stream free with trials from DirecTV, Hulu + Live TV, or Fubo.
